action_items: Review-request path '/receipts/new' is not a real route — actual route is '/new-receipt' (App.js:69). Not a bug; just a documentation nit for the request itself.

During heavy WatchFiles reload storms (multiple back-to-back writes under /app/backend), the uvicorn --reload worker child occasionally becomes defunct and localhost:8001 stops answering (had to restart backend twice during this session). Not caused by user code but worth watching — consider `--reload-exclude tests/*` in the supervisor command so writing pytest files doesn't kick the worker.
